name: Grant Packet Assembler
tagline: Builds Georgia grant packets that survive a compliance read. Drafts only; you submit.
description: Turns the facts you paste into a Georgia grant packet for programs like OneGeorgia, GVRA, SBDC and PASS: eligibility, narrative, budget, an attachment checklist and a benefits-risk memo, each citing the official page. It drafts only - it never submits, emails or pays, and it keeps SSN and bank details out of memory.
author: Joseph
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
